properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
NKWESIGA Yesu Mukama,
Nkwesiga wekka:
Laba,ntodde-obulokozi
Bwa buwa.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Nkwesiga okunzigyako
Ebibi byonna:
Nkuvuunamidde,Mukama
-Omuddu wo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Nkwesiga-okunnongoosanga
N'omusaayi gwo;
Emisana nkwesigenga
N'ekiro.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Nkwesiga-okunnumggamyanga
Gye mggenda yonna;
Bulijjo naawuliranga
Ggwe wekka.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Nkwesiga-okumpanga amaanyi
Nze ndi munafu.
Olina gonna ggwe,mu nsi
N'eggulu.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Nkwesiga ggwe,Yesu,nneme
Okuzirika;
Mu byonna n'ennaku zonna
Nkwesiga.
